Once again Runduk will ask you to return to him when you have attained more [[sunspear promotion point]]s. This time he wants to see you when you've got the title "First Spear".

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
 |campaign = Nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
*Gain the rank of First Spear.
*Complete quests or help Sunspear scouts with conscription orders to earn Sunspear promotion points.
*See Runduk [Sunspear Rank Officer] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 15 [[Attribute point]]s

==Walkthrough==
Basically the same as with [[Rising in the Ranks: Master Sergeant]]. Go out and do quests and slay monsters for which you have a [[bounty]]. As soon as you reach the rank of First Spear in your title track your quest log will update and you can go back to Runduk to collect your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Runduk
:''The Order of the Sunspears rewards honor and bravery. As you progress through your career, not only can you gain new titles, but additional power; and of course further responsibility. Once you have earned enough [[Sunspear promotion point|promotion points]] to gain the rank of a [[First Spear]] you will earn 15 additional attribute points you can assign however you see fit.''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Sounds good to me!
|decline = Can't I jump straight to Spearmarshall?
|ask = I am here if you have any questions. Once you have earned enough [[Sunspear promotion point|promotion points]] to attain the rank of [[First Spear]], return to me. }}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Runduk
:''Well done, <Player name>! I have the honor of being the first to salute you. Congratulations on attaining the rank of First Spear. You must now hone your skills as a leader.''

==Note==
*From the reward dialogue of this quest and from the reward dialogue of the preceding quest can be concluded that Runduk is a Second Spear himself.
